name: Private Residence 3
desc: A warm contemporary home where soft ivory surfaces, sculpted curves and dark timber are layered with brass accents and ambient light.
desc2: Private Residence 3 balances understated luxury with a relaxed domestic character. Curved openings and furniture soften the open living and dining spaces, while fluted panelling, crafted timber, brass screens and illuminated niches add rhythm and depth. A restrained neutral palette allows artwork, textured finishes and sculptural lighting to give each space its own identity while maintaining a calm, cohesive whole.
imageAlt: Warm contemporary living room with curved furniture, ivory panelling, dark timber and brass accents
